conflicts.site: Second husband of Elizabeth M. McAvoy (b. 1897)
conflicts.found: Harold (Edward) Arnold, b. 1927 Pa., son of Harold George Arnold (1904-1959) and Martha Bowden (1908-1982); Wilkes-Barre 1930-1950; d. 1997 Altoona; husband of Elizabeth "Betsy" McGuire (b. 1928), Elizabeth McAvoy's daughter
conflicts.assessment: Almost certainly Elizabeth McAvoy's son-in-law, not her husband. Recommend moving him to Betsy (H0062, presumed living/skip list, so not researched).
